step_dag.name: reading list with provenance
step_dag.acceptance: candidate list carries provenance: primary sources only, each URL opened and verified at capture; the list is reviewed before any ingestion, and the review and its source are recorded on this step

step_dag.name: distill per-source notes
step_dag.acceptance: per-source notes exist as files, sources named in each Notes follow the notes-artifact discipline: one file per source, every claim tied to the passage it rests on, quotes short and exact; a note that cannot name its passage is not evidence. Sources are read at the page, never from a summary of the source.

step_dag.name: ingest as a bank operation
step_dag.acceptance: ingestion executed as a bank-operation task instance (never a bare dispatch); its id is recorded on this step

step_dag.name: verify by recall from the target bank
step_dag.acceptance: recall from the target bank returns the ingested content; evidence quotes the bank queried Retains that land in the kurisu-quality or kurisu-security banks are phrased as verified verdicts or findings - their extraction discards plain statements (2026-11-22).
